title: Indigenous Minga del suroccidente: Cali–Bogotá mobilization
scope: Indigenous movement with participants from at least eight departments
participants_original: Media estimate about 7,000; activists estimated about 10,000; do not select one as exact.
participants_precision: reported approximate estimates; not exact counts
threshold_50_evidence: The opened report gives discrepant estimates of about 7,000 (media) and 10,000 (activists) participants; each is clearly above 50, while exact count is unresolved.

date.note: S005 dates the convening to 8 October; no supported final date in available bodies.

location.note: S005 places initial gathering in Cali and describes arrival in Bogotá; S003 and S001 provide local stage reports.

participants.note: S005 reports conflicting rounded estimates, both well above threshold.

demands.note: S005 describes demands directed to the president/state, including a meeting, peace agreement implementation, autonomy and land processes.

open_questions: Find independent support for Minga closure/end date if duration is later coded.

title: National strike mobilization in Bogotá, 21 October
location: Bogotá, march routes including Parque Nacional/Plaza Bolívar
scope: City-level component of nationwide National Strike Committee call
organizer: National Strike Committee, union, education, health, Indigenous and student participants
participants_original: Approximately 1,000 participants reported for Bogotá; rough estimate only.
participants_precision: reported approximate estimates; not exact counts
threshold_50_evidence: Radio Nacional reports approximately 1,000 participants in Bogotá; it separately reports other city estimates, which are not pooled. Caracol records multiple national actions and cannot be read as one national crowd.

date.note: Both event reports date the action to 21 October.

location.note: S006 and S007 describe Bogotá routes/actions.

participants.note: S007 reports about 1,000 for Bogotá; do not combine with other cities.

demands.note: S006 describes demands addressed to the national government, including protection from massacres, peace accords and negotiation of the emergency petition.

open_questions: Confirm whether the approximate Bogotá citywide count maps to a single simultaneous gathering under the supplied codebook.
